cards.translation: 一夜情和真正放下，区别在哪儿？

cards.text: I'm here to take it all to the chin

keyWords.word: take it all to the chin

cards.translation: 我来这儿是准备硬扛下这一切

cards.text: This time stone cold sober
cards.translation: 这一次，清醒得不能再清醒

cards.text: And when you talk trash with your hair slicked back
cards.translation: 当你把头发往后梳得油亮、说起别人坏话的时候

cards.text: Scrap and claw for what we're dreamin' of
cards.translation: 为我们梦想的东西又抓又挠、拼命去争

cards.text: While those greedy politician boys all rat race
cards.translation: 而那帮贪婪的政客小子都在你争我夺

cards.text: But you'll always have these times to get you by when times are low
cards.translation: 但日子难的时候，这些时光总能帮你熬过去

cards.text: The moon's seepin' on Rogers County mud
cards.translation: 月光渗进罗杰斯县的泥地里
